demos = [demo1, demo2]
code = '''def transform(grid):
    nrows = len(grid)
    ncols = len(grid[0])
    objects = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 7:
                objects.setdefault(value, []).append((r, c))
    color, cells = max(objects.items(), key=lambda item: max(
        max(r for r, c in item[1]) - min(r for r, c in item[1]) + 1,
        max(c for r, c in item[1]) - min(c for r, c in item[1]) + 1))
    min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in cells)
    size = max(max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1)
    output = [[7] * ncols for _ in range(nrows)]
    top_r = max_r - size + 1
    for i in range(size):
        output[top_r + i][max_c - i] = color
    return output
'''
ns={};exec(code,ns)
checks=[ns['transform'](d['input'])==d['output'] for d in demos]

(p/'task-f9e46ccb.py').write_text(code)
